Name: Harvey dialogue for The Stardew Squad
Author: Isaldae
Description:
[size=6][b]Harvey's Squad Dialogue[/b][/size]
A content pack for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url][/b] that gives Harvey his own voice when he's tagging along with you!

[size=5][b]Description[/b][/size]
Harvey's tone changes based on how he feels about you, so his dialogue is split into three tiers:
[list]
[*][b]Low hearts:[/b] He's polite and professional, but treats every outing like a house call. Expect hydration reminders and gentle safety warnings.[/*]
[*][b]High hearts (6+):[/b] He's opened up. He's glad to be out of the clinic, enjoys your company, and lets his guard down.[/*]
[*][b]Spouse:[/b] Warm, affectionate, deeply caring. He'll fuss over you lovingly and share little moments about your life together.[/*]
[/list]He has unique lines for just about every task your Squad can do:
[list]
[*]Recruiting and dismissing him[/*]
[*]Walking around with you (with location-specific dialogue!)[/*]
[*]Fighting monsters[/*]
[*]Chopping trees, mining rocks, foraging, and harvesting[/*]
[*]Watering crops[/*]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Petting animals[/*]
[*]Rejection lines if you try to recruit him before he likes you enough.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🇨🇳 Chinese - by passersby10086[/*]
[*]🇫🇷 French - by ThaliaFawnheart[/*]
[*]🇰🇷 Korean - by snowstreet12[/*]
[/list]If you'd like to contribute a translation, send it my way and I'll add it in a future update!

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]NPC retextures:[/b] Compatible.[/*]
[*][b]Other Harvey dialogue mods for The Stardew Squad[/b]: Might conflict and override one another, unless both mods are purposefully compatible with one another.[/*]
[*][b]Dialogue mods outside of The Stardew Squad, or for other characters in TSS:[/b] Compatible.[/*]
[/list]
